needed.evidence: A large advertising board and a bus shelter structure occupy the sidewalk, narrowing the usable path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Relocate the advertising board and bus shelter to a position that leaves a minimum 1.5m clear width on the sidewalk.

needed.evidence: The kerbs at the pedestrian crossing appear to be at standard height with no visible dropped sections to assist wheelchair users or those with prams.
